title: Fault-Grown Violet Cluster
description: A splayed cluster of chipped violet prisms rooted in a split limestone shelf and exposed mineral earth; reference: ref_07_violet_crater.

review.notes: Round 2: approved. Reuses the approved proof make_crystal() and crystal_material() (accepted by lead decision): faceted prisms of varied size and tilt, with crisp terminations and the same internal facet patches and growth striations as crystal_violet_cluster_a. Base: layered grey limestone with bed planes, irregular moss and fractured edges, matching the reference (closeup_base). The scale reads well next to the figure. Polish, not blocking: a dark shadow pocket under the main prism at its foot (closeup_base) could get a small rock fillet or soil.
